currentSales.question: Show sales performance for the current quarter
currentSales.summary: Net invoiced sales for Q3 2026 to date are **{{total}}**, net of VAT and credit notes across all customer accounts.
currentSales.howCalculated: Sum of posted invoice net amounts less posted credit notes in EUR, net of VAT, for the period July 1 – August 15, 2026.
currentSales.blueprintSummary: Net invoiced sales for Q3 2026 to date are {{total}}, net of VAT and credit notes.

salesComparison.question: Compare sales with previous quarter and same period last year
salesComparison.summary: Current Q3 sales (**{{current}}**) are up **{{varQ2}}** ({{absQ2}}) compared to the equivalent 46-day window of Q2 2026 ({{q2}}), and up **{{varPY}}** ({{absPY}}) vs the equivalent Q3 2025 prior-year period ({{py}}).
salesComparison.howCalculated: Compares identical 46-calendar-day elapsed periods: Q3 2026 (Jul 1 – Aug 15) vs Q2 2026 (Apr 1 – May 15) and Q3 2025 (Jul 1 – Aug 15).
salesComparison.blueprintSummary: Current Q3 sales ({{current}}) are up {{varQ2}} vs equivalent Q2 2026 and {{varPY}} vs equivalent Q3 2025.

topCustomers.question: Give me the top 5 customers.
topCustomers.summary: The top 5 customers generated **{{top5Total}}**, representing **{{share}}** of total net invoiced sales ({{total}}).
topCustomers.tableTitle: Top 5 customers by net invoiced sales
topCustomers.howCalculated: Net invoiced sales are invoice totals minus credit notes and discounts for the period, grouped by customer. Share = customer total ÷ total net invoiced sales of all customers ({{total}}).
topCustomers.blueprintSummary: The top five customers generated {{top5Total}}, or {{share}} of {{total}} net invoiced sales, for the certified period.

supplierSpend.question: Supplier spend overview
supplierSpend.summary: Approved procurement spend was **{{total}}**; the top 5 suppliers account for **{{share}}** ({{top5Total}}) of it. SafeLogistics is ranked net of credit note (€50,000).
supplierSpend.howCalculated: Spend is posted supplier invoices minus credits in EUR, excluding VAT. SafeLogistics is net €50,000 after €5,000 credit note. Share = supplier spend ÷ total approved procurement spend ({{total}}).
supplierSpend.blueprintSummary: Approved procurement spend was {{total}}; the top 5 suppliers account for {{top5Total}} ({{share}}) of spend.

delayedOrders.question: Why are there delayed orders?
delayedOrders.summary: **{{orders}} sales orders** containing **{{lines}} lines** across **{{customers}} customers** are currently delayed, representing **{{backlog}}** in delayed backlog value.
delayedOrders.howCalculated: A sales order line is delayed when its approved commitment date has passed the local end of business day in Europe/Rome and open quantity > 0. Backlog is open qty × unit net price.
delayedOrders.blueprintSummary: There are {{orders}} delayed sales orders ({{lines}} lines, {{customers}} customers) with {{backlog}} delayed backlog value.

productionLinkage.question: Production linkage summary
productionLinkage.summary: **{{orders}} delayed production orders** are explicitly linked to delayed customer orders across **{{customers}} customers**, accounting for **{{linked}}** (**{{coverage}}**) of total delayed backlog ({{total}}). **Warning:** {{unlinked}} ({{unlinkedPct}}) of delayed backlog has no linked production order. Explicit linkage is evidence of association, not verified causation.
productionLinkage.tableTitle: Production orders linked to delayed customer lines
productionLinkage.howCalculated: A production order is linked when explicitly allocated to an open delayed sales order line. Coverage = explicitly allocated delayed backlog ({{linked}}) ÷ total delayed backlog ({{total}}) = {{coverage}}.
productionLinkage.blueprintSummary: {{orders}} linked delayed production orders affect {{customers}} customers with {{linked}} linked backlog ({{coverage}} coverage). {{unlinked}} remains unlinked.
productionLinkage.warning: Partial linkage coverage: {{coverage}} coverage by value. {{unlinked}} in delayed backlog is currently unlinked to production orders. Explicit linkage indicates association, not causality.
